# system.getSources

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Return the list of sources within a category.

```lua
local sources = system.getSources(category)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | number | yes |  |

## Returns

sources (Sources list)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
system.getSources(CATEGORY_TELEMETRY_SENSOR)
```
